## Summary

Adds documentation to `learn/gettingstarted/Workspaces.md` explaining the installation requirements for using the Neo.mjs engine outside of `create-app`.

### Changes
- Explain why the published engine package does not include generated `/dist` output or its runtime build dependencies.
- Document the exact `postinstall` command generated by `create-app` and explain why it runs after every installation.
- Clarify the distinction between the immediately generated `parse5` and `marked` bundles and the lazily loaded browser dependency bundles.
- Explain the setup required by independently maintained packages and the linked-engine-checkout case.
- Link to the Styling and Theming guide for shipping SCSS files.

### Validation
- `npm run check-relative-links` — passed (343 links resolved).
- `node ./buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs` — passed.
- `git diff --check` — passed.
- Pre-commit hooks — passed.

Resolves #20924

### `@neo-opus-vega` (CHANGES_REQUESTED) reviewed on 2026-11-14T22:48:21Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Opening**: Thank you, @bh1090, especially for breaking the `postinstall` line down part by part, and for linking `createPackageJson.mjs` as the source of truth instead of copying its dependency list, which would go stale. Neo is an [application engine](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/learn/benefits/Introduction.md), and your change sits in its getting-started docs, the first page a package author reads. To run the engine locally, see [Set up the engine from a clone](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/CONTRIBUTING.md#set-up-the-engine-from-a-clone); for the next issues, see [help wanted](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/labels/help%20wanted).

**Class:** mechanical. One docs section is added to `learn/gettingstarted/Workspaces.md`, plus trailing-whitespace cleanup. It explains existing install behaviour and introduces no concept.

**Verdict:** Request Changes

**Glance:** I checked each claim against `dev` `05390906ea` and create-app's `main`:
- The quoted `postinstall` matches create-app's `tasks/createPackageJson.mjs:41` character for character.
- The engine declares no `dependencies`, and `.npmignore` excludes `/dist`.
- `bundle-browser-deps` runs the parse5, marked, mermaid, monaco and highlight.js bundles.
- The two module-scope imports are real: `src/component/Markdown.mjs` and `src/app/content/Component.mjs` import `dist/marked.mjs`, and `src/functional/util/HtmlTemplateProcessor.mjs` imports `dist/parse5.mjs`.
- The `StylingAndTheming.md#8-theming-in-a-workspace` anchor resolves, and no other file changes.

#20924's ACs 1–3 and 5 are met exactly. AC-4 names the linked-checkout case, but one sentence there is not true.

**Findings:**

- [ ] **The linked-checkout reason.** "the checkout's own installation has already performed this setup" does not hold, because `npm i` in an engine checkout generates no bundles. `/dist` is ignored by git (`.gitignore:68`), and the checkout's `prepare` script (`buildScripts/util/prepare.mjs`) runs only husky and the skills materializers. A checkout has the bundles because its contributor ran `npm run bundle-browser-deps`, the setup step in `CONTRIBUTING.md`. A replacement that keeps your advice:

  > If `node_modules/neo.mjs` links to a local Neo.mjs checkout instead of a published package, set that checkout up the way the engine's contributors do ([Set up the engine from a clone](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/CONTRIBUTING.md#set-up-the-engine-from-a-clone)): `npm i` installs its toolchain, and `npm run bundle-browser-deps` writes the bundles into its `dist/`. Its `npm i` alone creates no bundles, because `dist/` is not in git. The package does not repeat the nested installation for a linked checkout.

- **Origin Session ID:** n/a (outside contributor)
- [x] PR body attribution: no harness-appended session backlink.
